info.title: sptmod
info.description: Request and response contract of the sptmod core services.

schema.title: Response Locate Directory Api Locate Directory Post
Response List Mods Api List Mods Post
Response Mod Files Api Mod Files Post
Response List Profiles Api List Profiles Post
Response Search Catalog Api Search Catalog Post
Response Browse Catalog Api Browse Catalog Post

BlockedUpdate.description: An installed mod whose newer version other installed mods block.
BlockedUpdate.title: BlockedUpdate

CatalogEntry.description: A cached mod joined with the installed state of the game repository.
CatalogEntry.title: CatalogEntry

CatalogMod.description: A mod as cached in the local Forge catalog.
CatalogMod.title: CatalogMod

CatalogSourceLink.description: A labeled source-code link of a catalog mod.
CatalogSourceLink.title: CatalogSourceLink

CatalogVersion.description: A mod version as cached in the local Forge catalog.
CatalogVersion.title: CatalogVersion

CheckResult.description: What a residue check over all mods and all profiles found.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

CleanupPlan.description: What cleaning the profiles of one mod would remove.
CleanupPlan.title: CleanupPlan

CommitInfo.description: A commit with its parsed trailers.
CommitInfo.title: CommitInfo

Conflict.description: A finding of the pre-install conflict and dependency checks.
Conflict.title: Conflict

DirectoryEntry.description: One subdirectory of a browsed directory.
DirectoryEntry.title: DirectoryEntry

ErrorDetails.description: The structured payload a failed operation carries, empty where it has none.
ErrorDetails.title: ErrorDetails

ErrorResponse.description:
Body of every failed request.

``code`` is the stable machine-readable name of the core exception class,
``error`` its human-readable message.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FavoritesResponse.description: The Forge ids of all mods marked as favorites.
FavoritesResponse.title: FavoritesResponse

ImportDiff.description: The difference between an imported mod list and the installed mods.
ImportDiff.title: ImportDiff

ImportEntry.description: One mod an imported list and the installed mods disagree about.
ImportEntry.title: ImportEntry

ImportListRequest.description:
Parameters of ``import_list``.

Exactly one of ``list_file`` and ``content`` carries the mod list.
ImportListRequest.title: ImportListRequest

IncompatibleMod.description: An installed mod without any version for the queried SPT release.
IncompatibleMod.title: IncompatibleMod

InitGameDirRequest.description:
Parameters of ``init_game_dir``.

``spt_version`` answers the ``SPT_VERSION_UNKNOWN`` error of an earlier
call, which the setup flow repeats with the version a user entered.
InitGameDirRequest.title: InitGameDirRequest

InstallFromArchiveRequest.description:
Parameters of ``install_from_archive``.

``operation_id`` names the progress stream of this install; a generated one
is used and echoed back when the caller sends none.
InstallFromArchiveRequest.title: InstallFromArchiveRequest

InstallFromArchiveResponse.description: Outcome of ``install_from_archive`` plus its progress operation ID.
InstallFromArchiveResponse.title: InstallFromArchiveResponse

InstallModRequest.description:
Parameters of ``install_mod``.

``operation_id`` names the progress stream of this install; a generated one
is used and echoed back when the caller sends none.
InstallModRequest.title: InstallModRequest

InstallModResponse.description: Outcome of ``install_mod`` plus its progress operation ID.
InstallModResponse.title: InstallModResponse

InstallPlan.description: What an install would download and install, in install order.
InstallPlan.title: InstallPlan

LaunchProfileRequest.description:
Parameters of ``launch_profile``.

``operation_id`` names the progress stream of this launch; a generated one
is used and echoed back when the caller sends none.
LaunchProfileRequest.title: LaunchProfileRequest

LaunchProfileResponse.description: Outcome of ``launch_profile`` plus its progress operation ID.
LaunchProfileResponse.title: LaunchProfileResponse

LaunchStatus.description:
What of the installation is running right now.

The ``_stoppable`` flags say that sptmod can close this process: it started
it and it is still that same process. A process found only by its name, and
a server that was already running when the launch began, are reported but
never closed.
LaunchStatus.title: LaunchStatus

ManualMod.description: Untracked files below a mod path, grouped by their mod folder.
ManualMod.title: ManualMod

ModDetails.description: Outcome of ``get_mod_details``: cached data plus live description.
ModDetails.title: ModDetails

ModFile.description: A file touched by a commit, relative to the game directory.
ModFile.title: ModFile

ModInfo.description: A mod as described by the trailers of its most recent commit.
ModInfo.title: ModInfo

ModState.description: The lifecycle state a mod's youngest commit puts it in.
ModState.title: ModState

ModType.description: How a mod hooks into the game: server-side, client-side or both.
ModType.title: ModType

PlanEntry.description: One mod to install as part of an ``InstallPlan``.
PlanEntry.title: PlanEntry

ProfileResidue.description: IDs of one mod that one player profile still references.
ProfileResidue.title: ProfileResidue

ProfileSummary.description: One player profile file of the installation, as it presents itself.
ProfileSummary.title: ProfileSummary

ProgressEvent.description: One progress line of a long-running RPC operation on stdout.
ProgressEvent.title: ProgressEvent

ResidueCategory.description: Which part of a player profile a mod's IDs were found in.
ResidueCategory.title: ResidueCategory

SetSptVersionResponse.description: The SPT version stored for a game directory.
SetSptVersionResponse.title: SetSptVersionResponse

StatusReport.description: The interpreted working-tree status of a game directory.
StatusReport.title: StatusReport

StopResult.description: What stopping the game closed, and how to say so to the player.
StopResult.title: StopResult

SyncCatalogRequest.description:
Parameters of ``sync_catalog``.

``operation_id`` names the progress stream of this sync; a generated one is
used and echoed back when the caller sends none.
SyncCatalogRequest.title: SyncCatalogRequest

SyncCatalogResponse.description: Outcome of ``sync_catalog`` plus its progress operation ID.
SyncCatalogResponse.title: SyncCatalogResponse

UntouchedResidue.description: Residue a profile cleanup leaves in place, and why it does.
UntouchedResidue.title: UntouchedResidue

UpdateCandidate.description: An installed mod Forge recommends a newer version for.
UpdateCandidate.title: UpdateCandidate

UpdateModRequest.description:
Parameters of ``update_mod``.

``operation_id`` names the progress stream of this update; a generated one
is used and echoed back when the caller sends none.
UpdateModRequest.title: UpdateModRequest

UpdateModResponse.description: Outcome of ``update_mod`` plus its progress operation ID.
UpdateModResponse.title: UpdateModResponse

UpdatesReport.description: What ``check_updates`` found for the installed mods.
UpdatesReport.title: UpdatesReport
